extracted.intended_audience: Georgia Tech faculty, investigators, and research staff planning or proposing large-scale sponsored research centers/institutes (typically > $10M) and their proposal teams
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and services for planning, developing, and launching large-scale sponsored research projects (e.g., centers or institutes) including collaboration planning, proposal development, and initial center start-up support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project type — formation of a center or institute
rubrics_metrics.description: Formation of a center or institute with multiple functions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a typical characteristic of the large-scale sponsored research projects the office supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team composition — cross-disciplinary and cross-institutional teams
rubrics_metrics.description: Engagement of teams that span disciplines and institutions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes building teams that bring together diverse expertise across disciplines and partner institutions for center-scale proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget scale — large proposed budgets
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed budgets greater than $10 million
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the scale of projects that the office typically targets for support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration Planning — develop a working team collaboration plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Guided sessions to develop a working team collaboration plan
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collaboration Planning is a team science-based approach recognized to improve project outcomes; delivered over several short sessions and designed for teams in early stages of team building and proposal development. Contact provided for service inquiry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Connection to partners — expand team expertise and capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: Connection to partners to expand team expertise and capacity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offered as part of the planning stage to broaden team capabilities and capacity for large projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Framing — align proposal to solicitation and agency goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Framing relative to solicitation and funding agency goals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strategic guidance includes tailoring the proposal narrative to match the funder's priorities and the specific solicitation language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengths-and-gaps analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Identification of strengths and gaps
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of strategic guidance: assess the team's and project’s strengths and weaknesses to inform proposal strategy and mitigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency engagement — communication with agency officials
rubrics_metrics.description: Communication with agency officials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advises and supports proactive interactions with program officers and other agency contacts as part of strategic preparation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Site-visit preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation for site visits
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides tailored support to prepare for funder site visits as part of developing and launching center proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project management — checklists and timelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Development and management of checklists and timelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports creation and upkeep of project schedules and task lists to keep proposal development on track.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project management — facilitation of team meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: Facilitation of team meetings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers facilitation services to help cross-disciplinary teams coordinate effectively during proposal development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project management — coordination of proposal support team
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordination of proposal support team
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manages and coordinates the internal proposal support roles and responsibilities (e.g., writers, administrators, designers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal content — writing templates tied to solicitation/review criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Development of writing templates based on solicitation and review criteria
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creates templates that map content to funder requirements and known review criteria to improve alignment and readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal review processes — internal and external reviews (including red team)
rubrics_metrics.description: Management of internal and external (e.g., red team) reviews
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizes staged reviews, including external 'red team' critiques, to identify weaknesses and strengthen submissions prior to submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal review and editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal review and editing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides hands-on editing and review to improve clarity, responsiveness to solicitation, and overall quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Connection to resources — consultations with experts and partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Consultations with experts and partners
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Arranges consultations to bring subject-matter expertise or partner input into proposal development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal services — graphic design and other production help
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal services (e.g., graphic design)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers production services such as graphics to improve proposal presentation and readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curated written resources for specialized proposal elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Curated written resources for specialized proposal elements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintains and provides templates and sample language for elements that often require specialized treatment in large proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: GT Facilities Library — repository of campus resource descriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: The GT Facilities Library is a centralized repository of descriptions of campus resources. The Library was established by the Office of Research Development to assist faculty and staff with descriptions of Georgia Tech facilities and other resources in proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access via SharePoint or Teams requires GT credentials; use the Library to accurately describe campus facilities and resources in proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Launch support — guidance on operational best practices and institutional processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on operational best practices and institutional resources and processes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides strategic advice for the initial center launch period to translate awards into sustainable operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Launch oversight — administrative, financial, hiring, and communications workflows
rubrics_metrics.description: Oversight of administrative, financial, hiring, communications, and other workflows
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assists in establishing and overseeing core operational workflows needed to initiate center activities after award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing and tailored support — contact early; support depends on capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide support packages tailored to the needs and resources of the investigator team. Support depends on the office's capacity at the time of the request. Please contact the Director of the Office of Research Development as early as possible to inquire about support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendation to engage the office early in planning to secure appropriate, tailored support; availability is dependent on office capacity.
